description: Least-privilege surface for the lindo-md window. The webview gets no filesystem or shell access: reading files, scanning folders, watching for changes and writing exports all go through allowlisted #[tauri::command] functions in Rust. Window permissions are present because the window is frameless and the titlebar is drawn by us. The updater grants are the one place the webview can cause a binary to be fetched and run: what it can install is bounded not by this file but by the minisign public key in tauri.conf.json, so an update the release key did not sign is rejected in Rust before anything is executed.
